verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
How lovely on the mountains are the feet of Him
Who brings good news, good news

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Announcing peace
Proclaiming news of happiness
Our God reigns, our God reigns

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Our God reigns, our God reigns
Our God reigns, our God reigns

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
He had no stately form, He had no majesty
That we should be drawn to Him

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
He was despised and
We took no account of Him
Yet now He reigns, with the Most High

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Now He reigns, now He reigns
Now He reigns, with the Most High

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
It was our sin and guilt that
bruised and wounded Him
It was our sin that brought Him down

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
When we like sheep had gone astray
Our Shepherd came
And on His shoulders bore our shame

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
On His shoulders, on His shoulders
On His shoulders, he bore our shame

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
Meek as a lamb that's led out to the slaughterhouse
Dumb as a sheep before its shearer

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
His life ran down upon the
ground like pouring rain
That we might be born again

verse.name: v4c
verse.lines:
That we might be, that we might be
That we might be born again

verse.name: v5a
verse.lines:
Out from the tomb He came
with grace and majesty
He is alive, He is alive

verse.name: v5b
verse.lines:
God loves us so, see here His hands,
His feet, His side
Yes we know, He is alive

verse.name: v5c
verse.lines:
He is alive, He is alive
He is alive, He is alive
